# 7Rays Astro Vastu

> 7Rays Astro Vastu is a scientific Vedic Vastu Shastra and Astro-Vastu consultancy based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Founded by Certified Vastu Consultant Rishwa Sinha, 7Rays provides non-demolition spatial energy harmonization, environmental geopathic stress audits, and Vedic astrology consultations across India (pan-India) and internationally.

## Scientific Methodology & Core Principles
- **100% Non-Demolition Remediation**: All spatial corrections are achieved without structural demolition. Remedies employ elemental balancing (Pancha Tattva: Water, Air, Fire, Earth, Space), 16-zone spatial calibration, metallic energy inlays (brass, copper, zinc, lead), directional energy reflectors, and purposeful spatial realignment.
- **Diagnostic Instrumentation**: Physical audits utilize calibrated digital compass orientation, digital Gauss meters for electromagnetic field (EMF) analysis, and dowsing instruments for environmental geopathic stress grid evaluation.
- **Astro-Vastu Synthesis**: Unifies spatial Vastu orientation with classical Vedic astrology (Janma Kundli) and planetary transit cycles (Mahadasha/Antardasha) to diagnose why specific occupants experience localized energetic blockages.
- **Ethical Consultation Standard**: Strictly provides root-cause spatial adjustments and classical timing analysis; does not sell overpriced commercial gemstones or promote fear-based superstition.
